capabilities: Review notes with an AI provider and produce structured verdicts with scores, summaries, tags, and action recommendations
Auto-move reviewed notes into Archive, Read Later, or Tasks folders based on confidence thresholds
Batch-process a watched folder with rate limiting, a queue monitor, and undoable auto-sort runs
Fetch URL-only notes' article text and send images or extracted PDF text to multimodal models
Run cross-note collection reviews of selected notes or folders
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true). AI API usage may incur provider costs. The optional FAQ page loads a Ko-fi donation widget and opt-in Google Analytics 4; the plugin core is telemetry-free. PDF text extraction is experimental.
motivation: The README describes an intended clip-to-review-to-organize pipeline where every clipped note is automatically queued for AI review the moment it lands in the Inbox.
problem: Obsidian users accumulate unprocessed notes in an inbox folder and must manually read, summarize, and file each one, which is slow for large daily intake like clipped web articles.

relations.evidence: This plugin pairs perfectly with Obsidian Web Clipper

requires.name: OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic API key
Developer account with an AI provider

summary: AI-powered plugin that reviews, summarizes, and auto-sorts inbox notes into Archive, Read Later, or Tasks folders using LLM APIs.
